text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Woooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe puts on a great performance and holds her own even against the senior year racers. However…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: The gap widened again…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: At the Kikuka Sho… I was closer to her… But why?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Um, Cafe? Nice running out there today.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Do not speak to her, Doto!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh? But why not, Opera O?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I realized as we were running together. We cannot involve ourselves with her. At least, not at the track.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: That one is… unlike us. She is one who ventures to strange worlds…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: She is… the companion of Leckermaul.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Lick 'em all…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Cafe! That was quite fantastic!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Heading through the runners' tunnel, we're engulfed in joyous cheers.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I really think so. Figuratively speaking, it's as if this is the calm before your storm! I wonder how far you'll be able to go?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Let's find out next year. Or rather, allow me to observe as you find out. How exciting!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon buzzes with exhilaration. Manhattan Cafe, however, is standing completely still and looks deathly pale.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Trainer… My friend… My friend has…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: She's… faster now… Much, much faster…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As we head home, I struggle to come to terms with what Manhattan Cafe said.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: It's as if… she sped up in response to me getting faster…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: But why… Why?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Why, why, why?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Crack!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Ugh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the sound of a nail breaking. Although her weight has been stable for a while…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The shadow hanging over Manhattan Cafe lingers on. Like it's a curse… or some step we can't skip…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I can catch her. I'll prove it.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Next year, I'll do it… I'm different now. I'm not weak anymore…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: What should our next goal be?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thump!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I feel like something just… walloped me in the stomach. Something with… a powerful hold over me…
choice_data_list: Next up… is the spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: The spring Tenno Sho… That's a 3,200 meter race…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: So you think I'll have a better chance of reaching my friend if the race is that long?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's nothing wrong with our approach. We've set our sights on a big G1 race in the spring, and there's no better example than the spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But what I said just now… Was that really my idea?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Crack! Crack, crack!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I'll show you I can catch up to her. I know I can do it…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe's classic year comes to an end after a quiet spring and a successful fall.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's not as frail as she used to be… but a deep yearning has taken root inside her—something profoundly… melancholic.
